claim_boundary: This is an offline execution-aware proxy diagnostic. It is not PnL, not live-trading evidence and not a production execution simulator.

claims.claim_text: ChronosLOB provides offline execution-aware proxy diagnostics over stored FI-2010 forecasts.
claims.safe_rewording: Offline execution-aware proxy diagnostics are implemented and run from retained tables; this is an implementation claim, not a profitability or live-trading claim.
claims.scope: retained execution-v3 confidence-filtering and cost tables

claims.claim_text: Cost-adjusted proxy degradation is characterised across a cost grid.
claims.safe_rewording: Report cost-adjusted proxy degradation by fee and spread multiplier; these are proxies, not realised PnL.
claims.scope: cost_sensitivity_summary across fee and spread-multiplier settings

claims.claim_text: Row-step latency sensitivity is characterised by horizon and objective.
claims.safe_rewording: Report row-step latency degradation of the proxy by horizon; this is a latency sensitivity proxy, not a live latency measurement.

claims.claim_text: Fill-assumption sensitivity is characterised across proxy fill modes.
claims.safe_rewording: Report fill-assumption sensitivity across proxy fill modes; fills are assumptions, not exchange-confirmed executions.

claims.claim_text: An adverse-selection proxy is characterised by confidence bucket.
claims.safe_rewording: Report the adverse-selection proxy rate by confidence bucket; it is a label/move proxy, not measured adverse selection.
claims.scope: adverse_selection_proxy_summary by confidence bucket and fill assumption

claims.claim_text: Execution-aware diagnostics are broken down by market regime.
claims.safe_rewording: Regime diagnostics are skipped because regime labels and snapshot context columns are not present in the retained artefacts.
claims.scope: regime diagnostics require regime labels or snapshot context columns

claims.claim_text: Execution-v3 demonstrates profitability, realised PnL, live trading or production execution quality.
claims.safe_rewording: State that execution-v3 is an offline execution-aware proxy diagnostic and is not PnL, not live-trading evidence and not a production execution simulator.
claims.scope: blocked by release policy; these diagnostics are offline proxies only
